text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah, haah, haah-- Whew.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: “...It's tomorrow. Finally, tomorrow—”

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Teio-san.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Huh... Ah, Zephyr?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Good work. ...Tomorrow is finally the 
Arima Kinen, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Wait, I mean! I never expected you to 
enter too!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Speaking of the Arima Kinen, isn't that a 
long-distance race? Don't tell me you're 
aiming for a four-division conquest!?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Fufu... That is true.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Long-distance races are like a furious 
gale. But... I felt I should dive right 
into it without fear.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Because... raging within it is a gale 
poised to bring about a miracle.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
A dry winter wind is something one simply 
must bathe in directly.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: ...In short, you wanna run with me?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: That is the case.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I see, I see. ...Nishishi.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Geez, another troublesome rival just 
showed up!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Fufu... Ah, and another thing.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: ...This is a refreshment for you.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ah!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Waaaaah!! It's Hachimii!! Yay, yay, 
yaaay!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And on the day of the Arima Kinen...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: ...Everyone!! Sorry to keep you waiting!!

text_block_list.name: Teio's Fans
text_block_list.text:
Ah, aaaaah... It's really... It's really, 
truly, Tokai Teio...!

text_block_list.name: Teio's Fans
text_block_list.text:
Tokai Teiooooo!! I've been waiting!! I've 
been waiting for you all this time!

text_block_list.name: Teio's Fans
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOO!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
L-Listen to this tremendous roar from the 
crowd...! Tokai Teio is!! Tokai Teio, the 
undefeated Double Crown Umamusume, is—!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Overcoming repeated injuries and a long 
period of rehabilitation, she has now... 
stepped into the paddock of the Arima 
Kinen...!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Teio-san. I look forward to working with 
you today.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Zephyr... Yeah, let's do this.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
You are strong. And so is everyone else. 
You might not be able to run like you used 
to.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I understand everything. ...But I'll still 
show you I can do it!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I am Tokai Teio. The invincible 'Emperor' 
who will create miracles and surpass the 
'Emperor'!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...A summer tempest, isn't it? Stronger 
than at any moment before.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: That is precisely why—I must, too.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I shall become the wind. A mighty gale 
that swallows even your miracles.
